issues: The summary gets the bug backwards. The problem was that G/L entries moving the amount between receivables accounts were posted with ACY = 0. The fix does not make zero-ACY entries post correctly.
The key point saying amounts were not transferred is wrong. The amounts moved; only the ACY was missing.
The codeunit count is wrong. The change touches 11 layer copies of Gen. Jnl.-Post Line plus the CZ Gen.Jnl. Post Line Handler, not 12 localized versions of the codeunit.
